## About the grant
As of August 1st, Luisa Kutlar has joined the lab as part of the WEAVE grant. Funded through the Weave line by the DFG and FWF (€398,703), the project studies the diversity of cross-platform news flows in the German media system. Luisa will cooperate with Prof. Valerie Hase, Ass.-Prof. Karin Boczek, and Lilith Blöbaum at KU Eichstätt-Ingolstadt.
